statements.status_notes: Disabled SSH host key verification in the EMR SSH helper commands, affecting awscli before 1.45.28, first fixed in 1.45.28. This image installs awscli at the version upstream GitLab CNG pins as a build argument in its gitlab-toolbox Dockerfile for the matching release tag, 1.44.58 for 18.11 and 1.44.59 for 19.1, and the newest CNG tags on both lines still pin those versions. The affected subcommands ship with the installed CLI and a user of this image can run them; backup-utility itself only calls aws s3 and aws s3api. Resolves when CNG moves its awscli pin to a fixed version.
